My dear [Cordelia](/person/1593)
I shall be very glad to see you and [Alethea](/person/1581) on Wednesday - tomorrow afternoon if you can come out. I am sorry I can say no more, but Thursday is [Mother’s Meeting](/organisation/31) day.

Friday School, Saturday a Sunday School meeting at the Vicarage.

And [Miss Walter](/person/1462) is so ill that I dare not make arrangements for more than that short afternoon time
your affectionate cousin

C M Yonge


[^1]: Cordelia Elizabeth Yonge (1874-1958) and Alethea Yonge (1876-1959) were the younger daughters of CMY’s cousin the Rev.

Duke Yonge of Puslinch.

The names were common in the family, but these seem to be the most likely candidates.
